visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with glasses and a black button-down shirt is the central figure, set against a background featuring a large, blurred image of a colorful bird. He speaks with high energy, using expressive hand gestures and dynamic facial expressions. (2) The scene transitions to include various digital overlays, such as scientific journal headers and diagrams illustrating bird flight and excretion. These overlays are sharp and clear, often appearing on the upper or middle parts of the screen. (3) Periodic cuts show actual footage of seagulls in their natural environment, both flying over the open sea and floating on the water's surface. The lighting is natural and bright during these segments. (4) The video frequently returns to the man in the studio, who continues to explain the scientific concepts while pointing towards the various text elements that appear around him. (5) Graphs and data tables related to the study on 'Periodic excretion patterns of seabirds in flight' are shown in close-up, providing a visual representation of the research findings.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male vocal track, speaking at a fast pace with varied intonation. A rhythmic electronic BGM with a strong beat sets an upbeat tempo. (2) A 'pop' SFX sounds as the first menu option appears visually. The speaker's pitch rises as he lists the options. (3) A 'ding' SFX marks the introduction of the scientific journal information. The BGM continues steadily in the background. (4) The speaker's tone becomes more explanatory as he discusses the 'Whale Pump' concept, with the BGM providing a consistent energy layer. (5) Every transition to a new visual slide is accompanied by a subtle whoosh or click sound effect, maintaining a high audio event density. (6) The video concludes with the speaker summarizing the findings, his voice remaining authoritative and energetic until the end, with the BGM fading out as the PanSci membership call-to-action is given.
